name: quick_noise_then_person
description: Just talk in a noisy room: a -42 dB fan runs from go-live and latches the room noisy before anyone speaks (the seated level is still unknown). Person 1 starts at 2.4 s, 12 dB over that noise floor, with Muse 0.8 s late: their voice is near, so it defers the icebreaker, their turn is kept (not dropped as bot speech) and the voices map Person 1 = A, Person 2 = B.

turns.text: Hi, is this seat taken or can I sit here for a bit before the talk?
Go for it, I am just waiting for the next session to start here.
